name: Schema statements
func:
return [["CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry (
  ts INTEGER, vehicle_id INTEGER, lat REAL, lon REAL, speed_kmh REAL, heading REAL,
  accel REAL, roll INTEGER, pitch INTEGER, flags INTEGER, battery INTEGER,
  rssi INTEGER, pdr REAL, distance REAL, ttc REAL, warn INTEGER);","CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alarms (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ts INTEGER, vehicle_id INTEGER,
  type TEXT, severity TEXT, lat REAL, lon REAL,
  acked INTEGER DEFAULT 0, ack_ts INTEGER, cleared_ts INTEGER);"].map((s) => ({ topic: s }))];

sql: INSERT INTO alarms (ts, vehicle_id, type, severity, lat, lon) VALUES ($ts, $vehicle_id, $type, $severity, $lat, $lon)

name: DB alarm clear
sql: UPDATE alarms SET cleared_ts = $cleared_ts WHERE ts = $ts AND vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND type = $type

name: DB alarm ack
sql: UPDATE alarms SET acked = 1, ack_ts = $ack_ts WHERE ts = $ts AND vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND type = $type

name: History every 10 s
topic: SELECT id, ts, vehicle_id, type, severity, acked, ack_ts, cleared_ts FROM alarms ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
